name: Glicko rating system
definition: Set q=ln(10)/400 and g(s)=(1+3q²s²/π²)^(-1/2). Inflate own RD to v=min(350,√(RD²+c²t)). For prior period opponents compute E_j=(1+10^(−g(RD_j)(r−r_j)/400))^(-1), I=q²Σg(RD_j)²E_j(1−E_j). Set RD_new=(v^(-2)+I)^(-1/2) and r_new=r+q RD_new²Σg(RD_j)(S_j−E_j)
variables: r,r_j ratings, RD standard deviations, c process inflation, t elapsed periods, S_j assigned Elo score, j opponent index
assumptions: Use simultaneous snapshots within a rating period
limitations: Sparse periods produce uncertain ratings and asymmetric expected scores
failure_conditions: Sparse periods produce uncertain ratings and asymmetric expected scores
computation: O(m) per rating update with m contests
